newsitem.title: ITALY: Max rate 8.38 on Italy 11 trln lire reverse repo.
newsitem.headline: Max rate 8.38 on Italy 11 trln lire reverse repo.

text.p: The maximum rate at today's 11 trillion lire reverse repurchase tender was 8.38 percent, the Bank of Italy said. The securities are for repurchase on October 7.
The average rate was 8.35 percent. The Bank said it received 46 bids of which 23 were met in full and seven in part.
The Bank last held a reverse repo on May 2. At that 10 trillion lire 12-day tender the maximum rate was 9.29 percent and average rate 9.23 percent.
